title: Finite-Time Minimax Bounds and an Optimal Lyapunov Policy in Queueing Control
abstract: arXiv:2506.18278v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce an original minimax framework for finite-time performance analysis in queueing control and propose a surprisingly simple Lyapunov-based scheduling policy with superior finite-time performance. The framework quantitatively characterizes how the expected total queue length scales with key system parameters, including the capacity of the scheduling set and the variability of arrivals and departures across queues. This characterization provides a systematic quantitative basis for evaluating and comparing scheduling policies in the finite-time regime, including nonstationary settings under certain assumptions on the model, and shows that the proposed policy provably and empirically outperforms the classical MaxWeight strategy in finite time. translated_title: 有限时间极小极大界限与排队控制中的最优Lyapunov策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.18278v4 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：我们引入了一个原创的极小极大框架，用于排队控制中的有限时间性能分析，并提出了一种极其简单的基于Lyapunov的调度策略，该策略具有优越的有限时间性能。该框架定量地描述了期望总队列长度如何随关键系统参数（包括调度集的容量以及各队列到达和离开的变异性）变化。这一特性为在有限时间范围内评估和比较调度策略提供了系统的定量基础，包括在模型特定假设下的非平稳设置，并表明所提出的策略在有限时间内理论上和经验上均优于经典的MaxWeight策略。在此框架内，我们建立了三组主要结果。首先，我们通过一种新颖的Br技术，为并行队列调度推导出期望总队列长度的极小极大下界。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的极小极大框架和简单的Lyapunov调度策略，显著优于MaxWeight策略，在有限时间内提供了最优的队列长度性能界限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel minimax framework and a simple Lyapunov scheduling policy that provably outperforms MaxWeight, offering optimal queue length bounds in finite time.
